todos.text: [P0] Design surface: treat a missing design directory as an empty state; acceptance: a cold start and repeated surface refreshes produce no `Not found: design` IPC errors

[P0] Bound persisted tool output: keep a short preview in hot.json and move full output to a separate log; acceptance: one large command cannot grow the active transcript by about 1 MB and archive/search still work

[P0] Validate a recorded model against the live provider catalog when resuming a session; acceptance: stale IDs such as `chatgpt-astra` cannot be sent and the UI offers a valid replacement with a clear explanation

[P1] Profile the observed ~20 s dev startup with boot marks around stores, provider probes, permission broker, remembered windows and snapshot serving; acceptance: the blocking stage is identified and startup work is moved off the critical path where safe
[P1] Make Linux E2E a blocking CI gate after stabilizing the runner; acceptance: remove `continue-on-error` and keep all 8 current Playwright scenarios green on Ubuntu

[P1] Remove validation warnings: migrate Vitest away from deprecated `environmentMatchGlobs` and make the boot-theme script bundling intent explicit; acceptance: typecheck, lint, unit tests and build finish without configuration warnings

[P2] Split the largest application modules and stylesheet by responsibility, starting with App, ChatView, main/index, session-manager and styles.css; acceptance: extracted boundaries have focused tests and no behavior regression
[P2] Reduce the 8.91 MiB renderer asset set by lazy-loading rare Mermaid/Cytoscape paths; acceptance: record before/after bundle sizes and preserve diagram rendering E2E coverage
